title: Monotonic Stack
intuition: Maintain a stack of elements in strictly increasing or decreasing order to solve next-greater element problems in linear time.
recognition_signals: Finding next greater or next smaller element
step_by_step_strategy: While stack is not empty and current element violates monotonicity, pop from stack.
common_mistakes: Popping indices instead of values by accident
Checking stack empty condition before pop
content: Maintain a stack of elements in strictly increasing or decreasing order to solve next-greater element problems in linear time.
